career_ladder.note: Agniveervayu candidates are enrolled in the Indian Air Force under the Air Force Act, 1950 for four years. On completion of four years, based on organizational requirements and merit performance, up to 25% are enrolled into the regular cadre of the IAF as Airmen in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3. Progression in the regular cadre follows standard IAF airman promotion ladders.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Agniveervayu consists of three phases. Phase-I is an Online Examination: candidates with Science subjects attempt English (20), Physics (25), and Mathematics (25) in 60 minutes; candidates other than Science attempt English (20) and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA 30) in 45 minutes; candidates opting for both attempt all subjects in 85 minutes. Marking scheme: +1 for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, and -0.25 marks for wrong answers. Phase-II comprises the Physical Fitness Test (PFT: 1.6 km run within 7 mins for males / 8 mins for females, 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups, 20 squats) and Adaptability Test-II. Phase-III is the Medical Examination conducted by IAF Medical Boards.

financial_package.note: During the 4-year tenure, Agniveervayu personnel receive a composite customized stipend package starting at ₹30,000 per month (Year 1: ₹21,000 in-hand + ₹9,000 corpus) and rising to ₹40,000 per month (Year 4: ₹28,000 in-hand + ₹12,000 corpus). Exiting Agniveervayu receive the tax-exempt 'Seva Nidhi' package of ~₹11.71 Lakh with accrued interest. Candidates enrolled in the regular IAF cadre (up to 25%) are placed in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3 (entry basic ₹21,700) with Military Service Pay (MSP).
financial_package.pay_source_label: IAF Agniveervayu Information Brochure — Remuneration & Regular Cadre Level 3 Scale
financial_package.estimate_note: For regular cadre Airman: basic pay ₹21,700 + 58% DA (₹12,586) + Military Service Pay (MSP ₹5,200 + DA) + standard allowances yields gross ~₹38,000 to ~₹47,000. During the 4-year Agnipath period, package is ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month.
official_perks: Seva Nidhi package of approximately ₹11.71 Lakh (with equal government matching contribution, completely tax-exempt) on completion of 4 years
Non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 Lakh for the entire duration of the engagement period
Free medical facilities, mess and boarding facilities across Air Force stations
Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹5,200 per month upon retention into the regular IAF airmen cadre
CSD Canteen amenities across Indian Air Force and armed forces stations
Skill certificate and 12th equivalent diploma credit under MSDE and IGNOU partnership upon exit
